messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Kate Lin <kate@novaledger.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Model selection sync: compact contexts and token traffic scenarios

Hi team,

Quick follow from today's kickoff with NovaLedger. They're looking for a pragmatic model shortlist and token traffic scenarios we can hand off to CS/implementation by end of week so engineering can start instance sizing.

Notes and asks:
- Recommended shortlist (we should pick 2): candidates include gpt-neox-20b-8k-quant, opt-13b-2k, and redwood-6.7b-2k. Marissa—can you confirm perf for generation quality vs cost? Ben—any immediate latency constraints that would rule out the 20B?
- Context window options: primary target is 2k (baseline), optional 8k for doc-heavy flows. We need token-per-request distributions for both.
- Please populate the attached token-scenarios.csv with expected token-in, token-out percentiles (P50/P90/P99) for the pilot (week 0–4) and steady-state (month 2+).
- Timeline: send shortlist + CSV back by EOD Thu (2026-06-30) so we can schedule infra sizing on Fri.

Attachments: token-scenarios.csv (stub) — CSV has columns scenario, p50_in, p90_in, p99_in, p50_out, p90_out, p99_out, notes
Shared links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-token-scenarios

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Kate Lin <kate@novaledger.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model selection sync: compact contexts and token traffic scenarios

On Sat, Jun 27, 2026 at 9:18 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick follow from today's kickoff with NovaLedger...

I ran a quick quality pass and smoke latency checks on the three candidates. Attaching bench_results.pdf with short notes — highlights below.
- redwood-6.7b-2k: best cost/quality split for short-form answers; average generation latency 120ms/token on p3dn-like nodes.
- opt-13b-2k: slightly higher latency (~180ms/token) but better at instruction-following for finance templates.
- gpt-neox-20b-8k-quant: strong long-context coherence but quantization adds variability; tail latency spikes under batching.

My recommendation: shortlist redwood-6.7b-2k + opt-13b-2k for pilot with 2k context, and keep gpt-neox-20b-8k-quant as an opt-in for the 8k trial if NovaLedger wants long docs.

Attachments: bench_results.pdf (summary + raw logs)

—Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Lin <kate@novaledger.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model selection sync: compact contexts and token traffic scenarios

Irene / Marissa — quick latency note from infra side:
- If NovaLedger's P99 for generation tokens exceeds ~600ms we need to move to dedicated GPU pools to hit SLOs for the pilot.
- For 2k contexts with expected batching, redwood-6.7b typically keeps p50/p90 well within budget; opt-13b pushes GPU utilization up ~15% but is still okay for scheduled pilot traffic.

Action: when you fill token-scenarios.csv include expected requests/sec and P90 request size; I'll run a quick capacity estimate and return a proposal.

—Ben

From: Kate Lin <kate@novaledger.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Thanks, Irene — this is very helpful.

We can confirm our initial pilot traffic profile: 350 reqs/min, median in 120 tokens, median out 70 tokens. We'll complete the CSV with the P90/P99 numbers by Wednesday. Novaledger is keen to start with the lower-cost 2k flow and evaluate 8k for a subset of users later.

Can we lock a target date for infra sizing review on Friday, 2026-07-02? We want to ensure procurement has the numbers for the Reserved Capacity ask.

Best,
Kate
Product Manager, Novaledger
